mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which can stimulate economic growth and increase consumer and business spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals economic weakness, which can lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite high UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate is high and payroll employment is low, it indicates a weak labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances where both UNRATE is high and PAYEMS is low.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate in a tightening monetary cycle can lead to decreased borrowing and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances despite high FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates supply chain issues, which can lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances despite low INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: When both retail sales and housing starts are high, it indicates strong demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are high.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate in an early expansion phase indicates a tight labor market, which can lead to inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances despite low UNRATE.
